r.privateToTheReissuer: The holder shows this credential only to a reissuer it has chosen, so that the reissuer can bind a derived credential to the key. A party that obtains it any other way has no license to rely on it, to retain it, or to link the key to the holder.
r.bindsForDerivationOnly: The holder declares that it controls this key for holder binding in credentials derived from the credential of which it is the issuee. The declaration confers no other authority, and a verifier MUST NOT treat the key as one of the holder's KERI signing keys.
r.keyNotAssertedSound: The holder declares that it controls this key. It does not assert that the key is uncompromised, generated soundly, or held in secure hardware, and a verifier MUST NOT read any of those into this credential.
r.bindingEndsOnHorizonOrRevocation: The binding holds from validFrom, or from issuance when none is stated, until validUntil or revocation, whichever comes first. A reissuer MUST check the registry before deriving, and MUST NOT derive a credential that outlives the binding.
